proposal.description: The valley-current comparator is mistaken for a peak current limit, so pwm_mask's PWM is cut on any clock where CP_trig is high, a cycle-by-cycle limit the design does not have
proposal.reason: In S_SS or S_RUN, if CP_trig goes high during a high-side on-time, PWM_out falls at once instead of following the modulator pulse up to the soft_start ceiling. The design only counts CP_trig per cycle in fault_arbiter's window and never truncates a pulse with it.

proposal.description: The supervisor's hiccup exit also waits for the synchronised valley-current comparator to clear, 'do not retry into a live overcurrent', although the header says a retry always follows hiccup_done
proposal.reason: If CP_trig stays high through S_HICCUP (a persistent overcurrent or short), the FSM never goes back to S_SS. En stays low, no more strikes build up, and latch_out never asserts. The design instead retries after the cool-down and latches on the third strike.

proposal.description: fault_LED shows outstanding strikes only while the supervisor is in S_RUN, taking 'blink through the clean-run window' to mean only that, so Red_LED1 does not blink during the hiccup cool-down or the soft-start retry
proposal.reason: With strike_level non-zero and no latch, Red_LED1 is held low in S_HICCUP and S_SS. It should follow the 4 Hz blink there, and this shows once the blink timebase has toggled (after 125 ms of run time). It blinks again only after S_RUN is re-entered.
